cycle.label: Renewal period
cycle.note: Oregon licenses renew every two years on June 30. CPE counts from the two years before: 80 hours, at least 20 each year (July–June), including 4 hours of Oregon ethics.

requirements.label: Total CPE
requirements.note: 80 hours each renewal period (OAR 801-040). Up to 20 extra hours from your previous period carry forward — not toward the yearly minimum.

requirements.label: Non-technical
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than 16 non-technical hours count each period.

requirements.label: Nano-learning
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. Nano-learning is limited to 10% of the required hours (8).

requirements.label: Oregon ethics
requirements.note: 4 hours of Oregon-specific ethics each period (Oregon statutes and rules, the Board's Code of Professional Conduct). We count courses with "Oregon" and "ethics", "laws" or "rules" in the title. If your principal office is in another state with an ethics requirement, those hours can count instead.

newLicensee.note: First period prorated at 3⅓ hours a month, counting the month your license was issued (OAR 801-040-0100)

licenseDateHint: Oregon licenses expire June 30 every two years.
issueDateHint: If your license was issued during this period, the hours are prorated from the month it was issued.
limitsNotTracked: Teaching and published articles combined: max half the hours.
Municipal auditors: 24 governmental hours per period (16 in governmental auditing).
recordRetention: Keep CPE records for 5 years after completing each course.
toVerify: Yearly minimum 20 (the Board's pages) vs 24 (one copy of the rule).
The 4 Oregon ethics hours aren't prorated for a new licensee.
